loss_mask: every real position supervised; padded positions carry target u32::MAX and weight 0
padding: none at fixture level; the training harness pads short rows with PAD and masks them
sequence_packing: one contiguous window of 64 tokens per row

split_verdict.reason: the corpus is one generator family of 32 modular arithmetic progressions; every row is a cyclic shift of the same progression, so any partition leaks the held-out distribution and the 100-step schedule reuses each example 25.0x on average
split_verdict.recommendation: keep this fixture frozen for Phase XVI numerical and dispatch qualification; run Phase XVII held-out evaluation on the separate document-level fixture in validation/fixtures/phase17

tokenization: pretokenized integer ids; no tokenizer is consulted
